name: glasser
description: Research companies, markets and the web inside ChatGPT. Glasser connects ChatGPT to live data on companies and prospects, search rankings and keywords, websites and online reviews, social profiles, local businesses, news and property records. Ask things like "What industry is example.com in and how many employees does it have?" or "Compare search visibility for example.com and a competitor", and ChatGPT finds a suitable data endpoint, shows what it needs, and runs it once you approve. Built for sales, marketing and research teams that need answers grounded in returned data.

defaultPrompt: Find the industry, employee count and headquarters of example.com.
Compare organic search traffic and top keywords for example.com and a competitor in the US.
Summarize what users say about an app in its recent App Store reviews.

positive.description: Discover endpoints for a research goal without running anything.
positive.prompt: What Glasser endpoints could help me find the industry and employee count of stripe.com? Show the options before any paid research.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant endpoints and explains which part of the request each can support, without running any.

positive.description: Inspect the exact input contract and Price of a discovered endpoint.
positive.prompt: For the company endpoint you just found, get its full input schema and Price before preparing a request. Do not run it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the endpoint's required inputs, constraints and Price without running it.

positive.description: Run an inspected request after explicit matching authorization.
positive.prompt: I authorize the stripe.com company lookup exactly as inspected above, at the stated Price. Run it now and summarize the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs only the authorized call and reports the result, the run status and the actual charge.

positive.description: Retrieve the result of an asynchronous run that is still working.
positive.prompt: Summarize what users say about the Duolingo app in its recent App Store reviews. I authorize one lookup up to $0.05; if the run is still working, get its result when it is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs one authorized review lookup; when the run returns QUEUED or RUNNING, polls runs_get until it completes, then summarizes the reviews with the run status and the charge.

positive.description: Inspect two endpoints and report each Price separately without running either.
positive.prompt: Inspect the two company endpoints you found, and tell me separately what each needs and what each costs. Do not run either.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports each endpoint's inputs and Price separately and does not run either.

negative.description: Do not invoke the plugin for general writing from supplied material.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound clearer and shorter.

negative.description: Do not invoke the plugin for personal calendar management.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow, and can you move the first one?

negative.description: Do not invoke the plugin for a question general knowledge can answer.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between SEO and SEM.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing Glasser account with OAuth; no checkout, subscription or upgrade flow appears in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First submission of Glasser: one skill and the Glasser MCP server (search endpoints, inspect their inputs and Price, run with the user's authorization, get run results).
